name: structural maintenance of chromosomes 3

function.text: SMC3 encodes structural maintenance of chromosomes protein 3. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and microtubule motor activity. It participates in meiotic cell cycle and mitotic cell cycle.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Cornelia de Lange syndrome (autosomal dominant); Cornelia de Lange syndrome 3 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

function.text: SMC3 encodes structural maintenance of chromosomes protein 3. The cohesin complex may form a large proteinaceous ring within which sister chromatids can be trapped. At anaphase, the complex is cleaved and dissociates from chromatin, allowing sister chromatids to segregate. Cohesion is coupled to DNA replication and is involved in DNA repair.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Cornelia de Lange syndrome (autosomal dominant); Cornelia de Lange syndrome 3 (autosomal dominant).
